name: reprodecay-census-v0-3
title: Publication-anchored paired snapshots of Python research software
description: Eight linked static-observation tables for 692 publication-linked projects.

fields.name: snapshot_id
fields.description: snapshot_id, project_id, snapshot_role: snapshot and project keys; snapshot_role is publication or endpoint

fields.name: project_id
fields.description: snapshot_id, project_id, snapshot_role: snapshot and project keys; snapshot_role is publication or endpoint

fields.name: snapshot_role
fields.description: snapshot_id, project_id, snapshot_role: snapshot and project keys; snapshot_role is publication or endpoint

fields.name: symbol_key
fields.description: Comparison key <module>|<symbol_kind>|<qualified_name>.

fields.name: source_file
fields.description: Python source file.

fields.name: module
fields.description: Dotted module name derived from the path.

fields.name: symbol_kind
fields.description: Kind of definition.

fields.name: qualified_name
fields.description: Top-level name or Class.member.

fields.name: signature
fields.description: Argument list as written (classes: JSON list of base classes); variants joined by ' || '.

fields.name: decorators
fields.description: Decorators as written.

fields.name: export_evidence
fields.description: Why the symbol is considered public.

fields.name: line_start
fields.description: Source location of the first variant.

fields.name: line_end
fields.description: Source location of the first variant.

fields.name: variant_count
fields.description: Definitions with the same key (for example conditional definitions).

fields.name: snapshot_id
fields.description: snapshot_id, project_id, snapshot_role: snapshot and project keys; snapshot_role is publication or endpoint

fields.name: project_id
fields.description: snapshot_id, project_id, snapshot_role: snapshot and project keys; snapshot_role is publication or endpoint

fields.name: snapshot_role
fields.description: snapshot_id, project_id, snapshot_role: snapshot and project keys; snapshot_role is publication or endpoint

fields.name: source_file
fields.description: Root-level declaration file (or '(file)' rows refer to the whole file).

fields.name: source_kind
fields.description: Declaration format.
fields.x-allowed-values: pyproject | pep517 | pep621 | pep735 | poetry | poetry_dev | poetry_group | flit | setuptools_dynamic | setup_cfg | setup_py | requirements | conda_environment | pipfile

fields.name: field
fields.description: Declaration field, named by its path in the file (specification Section 2); '(file)' for file-level failures; 'setup(**...)' for an unresolvable keyword mapping.

fields.name: field_kind
fields.description: What the field carries.

fields.name: observation_status
fields.description: Observation status of the field (specification Section 4).
fields.x-allowed-values: extracted | extracted_partial | confirmed_absent | dynamic_metadata | unsupported_syntax | parse_failure

fields.name: entry_count
fields.description: Dependency rows produced by the field.

fields.name: unparsed_entry_count
fields.description: Of entry_count, rows with parse_status unparsed.

fields.name: detail
fields.description: Reason or source text for non-extracted statuses (for example the unresolved name, the file: reference, text_not_read_size_limit or link_target_unresolved).

fields.name: snapshot_id
fields.description: snapshot_id, project_id, snapshot_role: snapshot and project keys; snapshot_role is publication or endpoint

fields.name: project_id
fields.description: snapshot_id, project_id, snapshot_role: snapshot and project keys; snapshot_role is publication or endpoint

fields.name: snapshot_role
fields.description: snapshot_id, project_id, snapshot_role: snapshot and project keys; snapshot_role is publication or endpoint

fields.name: source_file
fields.description: File containing the declaration (an included requirements file for source_kind requirements_include).

fields.name: source_kind
fields.description: Declaration format.
fields.x-allowed-values: pep517 | pep621 | pep735 | poetry | poetry_dev | poetry_group | flit | setup_cfg | setup_py | requirements | requirements_include | conda_environment | conda_pip | pipfile

fields.name: dependency_group
fields.description: Declared role of the dependency.
fields.x-allowed-values: runtime | build | test | development | optional:<extra> | group:<name>

fields.name: normalized_name
fields.description: PEP 503 canonical package name; empty for directives and unparsed rows.

fields.name: raw_declaration
fields.description: Declaration as written in the source; table entries are rendered as '<name> = <value as JSON>'.

fields.name: specifier
fields.description: Version constraint in the source syntax (PEP 440, Poetry or conda); empty when unconstrained.

fields.name: marker
fields.description: PEP 508 environment marker, or the Poetry markers value.

fields.name: extras
fields.description: Requested extras, sorted and joined by ';'.

fields.name: attributes
fields.description: Other keys of a Poetry or Pipfile table entry (for example optional, python, git, path, source, or a list of alternative constraints).

fields.name: parse_status
fields.description: How the declaration was parsed (specification Section 3).
fields.x-allowed-values: parsed | parsed_poetry | parsed_pipfile | parsed_non_pep508 | parsed_url | directive | unparsed

fields.name: parse_error
fields.description: Parser error for unparsed rows.

fields.name: pair_id
fields.description: Pair and project keys.

fields.name: project_id
fields.description: Pair and project keys.

fields.name: family
fields.description: Compared family.

fields.name: feature_group
fields.description: Sub-family.
fields.x-allowed-values: declared_dependency | syntactic_symbol | packaging_files | build_backends | python_constraints | ci_providers | scalar

fields.name: feature_key
fields.description: Compared item: <dependency_group>|<normalized_name>, the API symbol_key, a list element or a structure field name.

fields.name: publication_value
fields.description: Value on each side (dependencies: sorted set of {specifier, marker, extras, attributes}); empty when the key is absent on that side.

fields.name: endpoint_value
fields.description: Value on each side (dependencies: sorted set of {specifier, marker, extras, attributes}); empty when the key is absent on that side.

fields.name: delta_type
fields.description: added: absent in the publication snapshot; removed: absent at the endpoint; changed: present on both sides with different values; unchanged: equal values.

fields.name: comparison_status
fields.description: comparable when the governing observation status is complete in both snapshots; incomplete_observation otherwise, in which case added, removed or changed may reflect a change in what could be observed.

fields.name: publication_evidence
fields.description: Source evidence for each side (file:line or the declarations behind the value).

fields.name: endpoint_evidence
fields.description: Source evidence for each side (file:line or the declarations behind the value).

fields.name: project_id
fields.description: Stable project identifier derived from the normalized JOSS DOI.

fields.name: pair_id
fields.description: Identifier of the publication/endpoint pair: project_id plus 12-character prefixes of both archive SHA-256 values.

fields.name: scholarly_doi
fields.description: Normalized (lower-case) JOSS article DOI.

fields.name: title
fields.description: Article title as supplied by Crossref.

fields.name: publication_date
fields.description: JOSS article publication date from Crossref.

fields.name: publication_year
fields.description: Year of publication_date; the stratum used in publication-year summaries.

fields.name: joss_url
fields.description: JOSS article page.

fields.name: input_repository_url
fields.description: Software repository URL declared on the JOSS article page.

fields.name: resolved_repository_url
fields.description: Canonical GitHub repository URL at endpoint resolution; differs from input_repository_url after a rename or transfer.

fields.name: selection_rank
fields.description: Position of the article in SHA-256 hash order of the frame. It fixed processing order only and is not a sampling weight or eligibility input.

fields.name: selected_role
fields.description: Frame role of the project.

fields.name: publication_archive_doi
fields.description: DOI of the archive record linked to the JOSS article (the publication snapshot).

fields.name: publication_archive_date
fields.description: Publication date of the archive record. The eligibility rule requires it to be no later than publication_date.

fields.name: publication_snapshot_id
fields.description: Foreign key to the publication row of snapshot_records.

fields.name: endpoint_snapshot_id
fields.description: Foreign key to the endpoint row of snapshot_records.

fields.name: endpoint_policy
fields.description: Rule that selected the endpoint: the latest non-draft, non-prerelease GitHub release, otherwise the default-branch head.

fields.name: endpoint_as_of_date
fields.description: Date to which the endpoint policy refers.

fields.name: endpoint_resolution_mode
fields.description: live: the policy was applied to the repository state on the endpoint date. retrospective_as_of: the policy was applied later to the repository history, restricted to releases and commits that existed at endpoint_as_of_date.

fields.name: endpoint_resolved_at_utc
fields.description: Time at which the endpoint was resolved (not the date of the selected release or commit).

fields.name: endpoint_ref_type
fields.description: Kind of reference selected by the endpoint policy.

fields.name: endpoint_ref_name
fields.description: Release tag or default-branch name.

fields.name: endpoint_commit_sha
fields.description: Git commit of the endpoint archive.

fields.name: endpoint_release_published_at
fields.description: GitHub publication time of the selected release; empty for default-branch endpoints.

fields.name: endpoint_commit_time_utc
fields.description: Committer time of the endpoint commit, read from the uniform member timestamps that git archive writes into GitHub tarballs; empty when timestamps are not uniform.

fields.name: endpoint_ref_date
fields.description: Date of the endpoint state: endpoint_release_published_at for releases, endpoint_commit_time_utc for default-branch endpoints.

fields.name: archive_to_article_days
fields.description: Days from publication_archive_date to publication_date (non-negative by the eligibility rule).

fields.name: article_to_endpoint_ref_days
fields.description: Days from publication_date to endpoint_ref_date: the observed post-publication interval.

fields.name: article_to_endpoint_as_of_days
fields.description: Days from publication_date to endpoint_as_of_date: the maximum possible interval.

fields.name: repository_archived_at_endpoint
fields.description: GitHub archived flag at endpoint resolution.

fields.name: repository_license_spdx_at_endpoint
fields.description: GitHub-reported license of the repository at endpoint resolution.

fields.name: snapshot_id
fields.description: Snapshot identifier: project_id, role and the first 16 hex characters of archive_sha256.

fields.name: project_id
fields.description: Foreign key to project_records.

fields.name: pair_id
fields.description: Foreign key to project_records.

fields.name: snapshot_role
fields.description: Role of the snapshot in the pair.

fields.name: source_provider
fields.description: Provider of the archive.

fields.name: source_identifier
fields.description: Archive DOI (publication) or owner/repository (endpoint).

fields.name: source_ref
fields.description: Archive file key (publication) or release tag or branch (endpoint).

fields.name: commit_sha
fields.description: Endpoint commit; empty for publication archives.

fields.name: source_url
fields.description: Public URL from which the archive can be reacquired.

fields.name: archive_bytes
fields.description: Size of the archive in bytes.

fields.name: archive_sha256
fields.description: SHA-256 of the archive bytes.

fields.name: upstream_checksum
fields.description: Provider-reported checksum (md5:<hex>) for publication archives; empty for endpoints.

fields.name: content_tree_sha256
fields.description: SHA-256 over the sorted list of (member path, size, member SHA-256). Equal values mean the same files at the same paths even when the archive bytes differ, for example after a hosting service re-creates a tarball.

fields.name: content_member_count
fields.description: Number of member files covered by content_tree_sha256.

fields.name: member_mtime_utc_mode
fields.description: Most common member modification time in tar archives; empty for ZIP archives.

fields.name: member_mtime_uniform
fields.description: Whether all tar members share member_mtime_utc_mode.

fields.name: parser_version
fields.description: Version of the static extractor.

fields.name: third_party_code_executed
fields.description: Safety assertion.

fields.name: snapshot_id
fields.description: snapshot_id, project_id, snapshot_role: snapshot and project keys; snapshot_role is publication or endpoint

fields.name: project_id
fields.description: snapshot_id, project_id, snapshot_role: snapshot and project keys; snapshot_role is publication or endpoint

fields.name: snapshot_role
fields.description: snapshot_id, project_id, snapshot_role: snapshot and project keys; snapshot_role is publication or endpoint

fields.name: archive_type
fields.description: Container format.

fields.name: archive_member_count
fields.description: Member files after removing a single wrapper directory and archive junk.

fields.name: archive_bytes
fields.description: Archive size in bytes.

fields.name: archive_sha256
fields.description: Verified archive hash.

fields.name: suspicious_member_count
fields.description: Members with absolute paths, '..' segments or drive prefixes; never extracted.

fields.name: link_member_count
fields.description: Symbolic or hard links. A text member that is a link is read as the member it points to inside the same archive (specification Section 1); nothing outside the archive is read.

fields.name: duplicate_normalized_member_count
fields.description: Path collisions after wrapper removal.

fields.name: skipped_large_text_count
fields.description: Text members not read because of the 2 MiB per-file or 128 MiB total limit.

fields.name: packaging_files
fields.description: Root-level declaration files present (specification Section 2).

fields.name: build_backends
fields.description: build-system.build-backend values in pyproject.toml.

fields.name: python_constraints
fields.description: Declared Python-version constraints, each prefixed by its source file.

fields.name: declared_dependency_record_count
fields.description: Rows of dependency_records for the snapshot (including directives and unparsed rows). A measurement of extracted record volume.

fields.name: unparsed_dependency_record_count
fields.description: Dependency rows with parse_status unparsed.

fields.name: source_python_file_count
fields.description: Python files selected as package source by the source-root rule.

fields.name: source_python_unread_file_count
fields.description: Selected package source files that could not be read within the size limits.

fields.name: source_python_line_count
fields.description: Physical lines in the selected package source files that were read.

fields.name: ast_parse_failure_count
fields.description: Selected source files that were unread or failed AST parsing.

fields.name: syntactic_api_symbol_count
fields.description: Rows of api_symbol_records for the snapshot.

fields.name: test_python_file_count
fields.description: Python files in test directories or named test_*.

fields.name: ci_workflow_file_count
fields.description: YAML files under .github/workflows.

fields.name: ci_providers
fields.description: CI systems detected from configuration file names.

fields.name: citation_cff
fields.description: Presence of CITATION.cff, codemeta.json or .zenodo.json at the root or under .github.

fields.name: codemeta
fields.description: Presence of CITATION.cff, codemeta.json or .zenodo.json at the root or under .github.

fields.name: zenodo_metadata
fields.description: Presence of CITATION.cff, codemeta.json or .zenodo.json at the root or under .github.

fields.name: contributing
fields.description: Presence of the corresponding governance or change-log file at the root or under .github.

fields.name: code_of_conduct
fields.description: Presence of the corresponding governance or change-log file at the root or under .github.

fields.name: security_policy
fields.description: Presence of the corresponding governance or change-log file at the root or under .github.

fields.name: changelog
fields.description: Presence of the corresponding governance or change-log file at the root or under .github.

fields.name: archive_listing_status
fields.description: Whether the member listing is complete (always complete for extracted snapshots).

fields.name: dependency_observation_status
fields.description: complete: every declaration field was extracted or confirmed absent; incomplete: at least one field is partial, dynamic, unsupported or failed; no_declaration_file: no supported declaration file at the root.

fields.name: dependency_incomplete_reasons
fields.description: source_file:field:status for each field that makes the dependency observation incomplete.

fields.name: python_constraint_observation_status
fields.description: complete when every field that can carry a Python constraint was extracted or confirmed absent and no declaration file failed to parse.

fields.name: build_backend_observation_status
fields.description: complete when there is no root pyproject.toml or it was parsed.

fields.name: source_line_observation_status
fields.description: complete when every selected package source file was read.

fields.name: api_observation_status
fields.description: complete when every selected package source file was read and parsed.

fields.name: parser_version
fields.description: Extractor version.

fields.name: third_party_code_executed
fields.description: Safety assertion.

fields.name: snapshot_id
fields.description: snapshot_id, project_id, snapshot_role: snapshot and project keys; snapshot_role is publication or endpoint

fields.name: project_id
fields.description: snapshot_id, project_id, snapshot_role: snapshot and project keys; snapshot_role is publication or endpoint

fields.name: snapshot_role
fields.description: snapshot_id, project_id, snapshot_role: snapshot and project keys; snapshot_role is publication or endpoint

fields.name: check_name
fields.description: Validation check.
fields.x-allowed-values: archive_sha256 | archive_paths | declaration_observation | api_source_read | python_ast_parse | python_ast_warning

fields.name: status
fields.description: Outcome.

fields.name: evidence
fields.description: Checked locator (snapshot, file or file:line).

fields.name: detail
fields.description: Hash, count or message.
